facts.text: Atmos may, in its sole and absolute discretion, close your account following any violation of the Risk Management Policy as determined by the Company; prohibited practices include using a different strategy on the funded account or arbitrage 'as determined by the Company in its sole and absolute discretion'.
facts.locator: Risk Management Policy clause 2; Customer Agreement §7.5

facts.text: Customers accept the Risk Management Policy, 'which may be amended from time to time at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion', and violations close the account.
20% consistency rule applies only to Instant-Funded accounts.
